evidence: The thickness of the as-deposited Ru films was determined by X-ray reflectance (XRR, PANalytical X'-pert MRD with Cu-K α radiation at 1.5 kW). The resistivity was measured by combining the sheet resistance of the Ru films measured by a four-point probe with their thickness. For phase and crystallinity identification, grazing-incidence angle (incident angle, θ= 3°) X-ray diffraction (GIAXRD, PANalytical X'-pert MRD) was performed. Plan-view transmission electron microscopy (TEM, Tecnai F20 equipped with 200 kV accelerating voltage and field emission gun) was used to examine the microstructures of the as-deposited or annealed ALD-Ru films. The impurities in the as-deposited and annealed Ru films, such as oxygen and carbon, were analyzed by secondary ion mass spectroscopy (SIMS, CAMECA IMS-6f in Korea Basic Science Institute) depth profiling. The SIMS results were calibrated by Rutherford backscattering spectrometry (RBS).
